title: Many Many Mods I - MMM1
description: Adventure Mod-Pack with many QoL-Features and over 100 Mods.
body:
**Many Many Mods I** includes popular mods like [Create (Fly)](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-fly), [Oh The Biomes We've Gone](https://modrinth.com/mod/oh-the-biomes-weve-gone), and nearly all of [Macaw's](https://modrinth.com/user/sketchmacaw) Mods.
The modpack also features new structures from [Moog's End Structures](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/moogs-end-structures), [Philip's Ruins](https://modrinth.com/mod/philips-ruins), and many more.

The [Ender Dragon fight](https://modrinth.com/datapack/true-ending) has been expanded, and there is also plenty of new food from [Farmer's Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/farmers-delight) and its addons.

Additionally, the pack adds many small quality-of-life features, such as smoother item swapping in the inventory, the ability to sit on stairs and slabs, beautiful water waves, more realistic sounds, player death corpses, and MUCH MORE.

Check out MMM's official collection: [Many Many Mods - MMM](https://modrinth.com/collection/2RaD3qPW) for new releases and our official [Discord server](https://discord.gg/N4qKnsrnDs)!

Enjoy the first release of the **Many Many Mods** series – **MMM1 is out now!**
